/* ErrorMessage uses the shared red ink token. */

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref, useAttrs } from "vue";
import TextInput from "./TextInput.vue";
import Textarea from "./Textarea.vue";
import Select from "./Select.vue";
import Checkbox from "./Checkbox.vue";

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false });

type FormControlType =
  | "text"
  | "email"
  | "password"
  | "number"
  | "search"
  | "tel"
  | "url"
  | "textarea"
  | "select"
  | "checkbox";
type FormControlSize = "xs" | "sm" | "md" | "lg";
type FormControlVariant = "subtle" | "outline" | "ghost";
type SelectValue = string | number;
type SelectOption =
  | string
  | {
      label: string;
      value: SelectValue;
      disabled?: boolean;
    };

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    type?: FormControlType;
    modelValue?: string | number | boolean | null;
    size?: FormControlSize;
    variant?: FormControlVariant;
    label?: string;
    description?: string;
    error?: string;
    required?: boolean;
    rows?: number;
    options?: SelectOption[];
    id?: string;
    class?: string;
  }>(),
  {
    type: "text",
    size: "sm",
    variant: "subtle",
    label: "",
    description: "",
    error: "",
    required: false,
  },
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  "update:modelValue": [value: string | number | boolean | null];
}>();

const attrs = useAttrs();
const controlRef = ref<{ focus?: (options?: FocusOptions) => void } | null>(null);

const resolvedComponent = computed(() => {
  switch (props.type) {
    case "textarea":
      return Textarea;
    case "select":
      return Select;
    case "checkbox":
      return Checkbox;
    default:
      return TextInput;
  }
});

const forwardedAttrs = computed(() => {
  const out: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  for (const key in attrs) {
    if (key !== "class" && key !== "style") out[key] = attrs[key];
  }

  if (props.type === "checkbox") {
    out.size = props.size === "lg" ? "md" : props.size;
  } else {
    out.size = props.size;
    out.variant = props.variant;
  }

  if (props.label !== undefined) out.label = props.label;
  if (props.description !== undefined) out.description = props.description;
  if (props.error !== undefined) out.error = props.error;
  if (props.required !== undefined) out.required = props.required;
  if (props.type === "textarea") out.rows = props.rows;
  if (props.type === "select") out.options = props.options;
  if (props.type !== "textarea" && props.type !== "select" && props.type !== "checkbox") {
    out.type = props.type;
  }

  return out;
});

function onUpdate(value: string | number | boolean | null): void {
  emit("update:modelValue", value);
}

function focus(options?: FocusOptions): void {
  controlRef.value?.focus?.(options);
}

defineExpose({ focus });
</script>

<template>
  <component
    :is="resolvedComponent"
    ref="controlRef"
    :id="props.id"
    :model-value="props.modelValue"
    v-bind="forwardedAttrs"
    :class="props.class"
    :style="$attrs.style as any"
    @update:model-value="onUpdate"
  >
    <template v-for="(_, name) in $slots" :key="name" #[name]="slotProps">
      <slot :name="name" v-bind="slotProps ?? {}" />
    </template>
  </component>
</template>
/* FormControl inherits the control tokens from the component it dispatches to. */
/* Radio inherits geometry from the radio-group tokens. */

<template>
  <div
    aria-hidden="true"
    class="espresso-skeleton animate-pulse bg-surface-gray-3"
  />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";

type SpinnerSize = "xs" | "sm" | "md" | "lg";
type SpinnerTheme = "gray" | "red";

const sizeMap: Record<SpinnerSize, { px: number; thickness: number; inset: number }> = {
  xs: { px: 12, thickness: 1.5, inset: 0.9 },
  sm: { px: 14, thickness: 2, inset: 1.05 },
  md: { px: 16, thickness: 2, inset: 1.2 },
  lg: { px: 20, thickness: 2, inset: 1.5 },
};

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    size?: SpinnerSize;
    theme?: SpinnerTheme;
    track?: boolean;
  }>(),
  {
    track: false,
  },
);

const colorClass = computed(() => {
  if (!props.theme) return undefined;
  return props.theme === "red" ? "text-ink-red-7" : "text-ink-gray-8";
});

const rootStyle = computed(() => {
  if (!props.size) return undefined;
  const dimensions = sizeMap[props.size];
  return {
    width: `${dimensions.px}px`,
    height: `${dimensions.px}px`,
    "--spinner-thickness": `${dimensions.thickness}px`,
    "--spinner-mask-thickness": `${dimensions.thickness}px`,
    "--spinner-inset": `${dimensions.inset}px`,
  };
});
</script>

<template>
  <svg
    width="16"
    height="16"
    role="status"
    aria-label="Loading"
    class="espresso-spinner inline-block shrink-0"
    :class="[colorClass, { 'espresso-spinner--track': props.track }]"
    :style="rootStyle"
  />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, inject, type Component } from "vue";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { TABS_KEY, panelId, tabId, type TabValue } from "./Tabs.vue";
import { TAB_LIST_KEY } from "./TabList.vue";

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    value: TabValue;
    label?: string;
    icon?: string | Component;
    disabled?: boolean;
    class?: string;
  }>(),
  {
    label: "",
    disabled: false,
  },
);

const slots = defineSlots<{
  prefix?: () => unknown;
  default?: () => unknown;
  suffix?: () => unknown;
}>();

const context = inject(TABS_KEY);
if (!context) throw new Error("<TabTrigger> must be used inside <Tabs>.");
const list = inject(TAB_LIST_KEY);
if (!list) throw new Error("<TabTrigger> must be used inside <TabList>.");

const selected = computed(() => context.selected.value === props.value);
const isVertical = computed(() => list.orientation.value === "vertical");

const sizeClasses = {
  sm: "h-8 px-2.5 text-sm",
  md: "h-9 px-3 text-sm",
};

const triggerVariantClasses = {
  underline: {
    base: "text-ink-gray-5 hover:text-ink-gray-7",
    selected:
      "text-ink-gray-8 after:absolute after:inset-x-0 after:-bottom-px after:h-px after:bg-outline-gray-8",
    verticalSelected:
      "text-ink-gray-8 after:absolute after:inset-y-0 after:-right-px after:w-px after:bg-outline-gray-8",
  },
  subtle: {
    base: "rounded-(--radius-3) text-ink-gray-5 hover:text-ink-gray-7",
    selected: "rounded-(--radius-3) bg-surface-base text-ink-gray-8 shadow-sm",
    verticalSelected: "rounded-(--radius-3) bg-surface-base text-ink-gray-8 shadow-sm",
  },
  ghost: {
    base: "rounded-(--radius-3) text-ink-gray-5 hover:text-ink-gray-7",
    selected: "rounded-(--radius-3) bg-surface-gray-3 text-ink-gray-8",
    verticalSelected: "rounded-(--radius-3) bg-surface-gray-3 text-ink-gray-8",
  },
  "browser-tab": {
    base: "rounded-t-(--radius-4) text-ink-gray-5 hover:text-ink-gray-7",
    selected:
      "-mb-px rounded-t-(--radius-4) border border-outline-gray-2 border-b-surface-base bg-surface-base text-ink-gray-8",
    verticalSelected:
      "-mr-px rounded-l-(--radius-4) border border-outline-gray-2 border-r-surface-base bg-surface-base text-ink-gray-8",
  },
};

const classes = computed(() => {
  const variantClasses = triggerVariantClasses[list.variant.value];
  return cn(
    "relative inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap font-medium outline-none transition-colors focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-outline-gray-4 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50",
    sizeClasses[list.size.value],
    variantClasses.base,
    selected.value &&
      (isVertical.value
        ? variantClasses.verticalSelected
        : variantClasses.selected),
    list.variant.value === "browser-tab" && "px-3",
    isVertical.value && "w-full justify-start",
    props.class,
  );
});

function onClick() {
  if (props.disabled) return;
  context.select(props.value);
}
</script>

<template>
  <button
    type="button"
    role="tab"
    :id="tabId(context.baseId, props.value)"
    :aria-selected="selected"
    :aria-controls="panelId(context.baseId, props.value)"
    :aria-label="props.label && !slots.default ? props.label : undefined"
    :tabindex="props.disabled ? -1 : selected ? 0 : -1"
    :disabled="props.disabled"
    data-slot="tab-trigger"
    :data-state="selected ? 'active' : 'inactive'"
    :class="classes"
    @click="onClick"
  >
    <slot name="prefix" />
    <span
      v-if="typeof props.icon === 'string'"
      :class="props.icon"
      class="size-3.5"
      aria-hidden="true"
    />
    <component
      v-else-if="props.icon"
      :is="props.icon"
      class="size-3.5"
      aria-hidden="true"
    />
    <slot>{{ props.label }}</slot>
    <slot name="suffix" />
  </button>
</template>
/* Part of the Tabs compound component. */
